findings.title: cylindrical lockset warranty years
findings.detail: Package states 10 years; spec requires at least 7 years.

findings.title: other electrified hardware warranty years
findings.detail: Package states 3 years; spec requires at least 3 years.

findings.title: other mechanical hardware warranty years
findings.detail: Package states 10 years; spec requires at least 5 years.

findings.title: CSA Heavy Duty Standard Compliance
findings.detail: Hardware must comply with CSA for Heavy Duty standard.
findings.why_it_matters: Using hardware that doesn't meet the CSA Heavy Duty standard could lead to premature wear or failure on high-traffic doors.

findings.title: Lock Cylinder Manufacturer
findings.detail: Lock cylinders must be Abloy of Canada; no substitutions allowed.
findings.why_it_matters: Only Abloy of Canada cylinders are approved; substitutions could compromise security or keying systems.

findings.title: Hinge Manufacturer
findings.detail: Hinges must be from approved manufacturers: Stanley, Monthard, Hager, or McKinney.
findings.why_it_matters: Approved hinge manufacturers ensure durability, proper function, and compatibility with fire-rated assemblies.

findings.title: Pivot Manufacturer
findings.detail: If pivots are used, they must be from Dorma or Yale-Corbin (Rixson).
findings.why_it_matters: Specified pivot manufacturers guarantee reliable operation and longevity for heavy or frequently used doors.

findings.title: Door Stop Manufacturer
findings.detail: Door stops, swing stops, and holders must be from approved manufacturers.
findings.why_it_matters: Approved door stop and holder manufacturers prevent damage to doors and walls and ensure proper operation.

findings.title: Flush Bolt Manufacturer
findings.detail: Flush bolts must be from approved manufacturers.
findings.why_it_matters: Approved flush bolt manufacturers ensure security and proper functioning of inactive door leaves.

findings.title: cylindrical lock manufacturer series
findings.detail: Package states ND Series; allowed: Corbin CL3300 series, Schlage ND series, Sargent 10 line, LSDA-800 series.

data.summary: The product data can be approved with the clarification notes below.

requirements.text: Door closers must have a minimum warranty of 10 years.
Exit devices must have a minimum warranty of 5 years.
Mortise locksets must have a minimum warranty of 10 years.
Cylindrical locksets must have a minimum warranty of 7 years.
Power door operators must have a minimum 2-year warranty on electronics.
Power door operators must have a minimum 5-year warranty on mechanical components.
Electrified locksets must have a minimum 2-year warranty on electronics.
Electrified locksets must have a minimum 5-year warranty on mechanical components.
Other electrified hardware components must have a minimum warranty of 3 years.
Other mechanical hardware must have a minimum warranty of 5 years.
Hardware must comply with CSA for Heavy Duty standard.
All hardware must be Grade 1.
Lock cylinders must be Abloy of Canada; no substitutions allowed.
Hinges must be from approved manufacturers: Stanley, Monthard, Hager, or McKinney.
If pivots are used, they must be from Dorma or Yale-Corbin (Rixson).
Door stops, swing stops, and holders must be from approved manufacturers.
Flush bolts must be from approved manufacturers.
Mortise locks must be from approved series with specified levers.
Cylindrical locks must be from approved series.

requirements.value: Schlage CO 100 x less cylinder x KP x 626
requirements.text: Push button code locks must be Schlage CO 100 x less cylinder x KP x 626.
Push button code locks must be Sargent KP Series.
Stand-alone alarm locks must be Detex EAX500 or Alarm Lock Pilfergard PG21.
Panic bar style locks (must re-latch) must be from approved manufacturers.
Mortise dead bolts must be from approved series.
Cylindrical dead bolts must be ILCO 4514.25.1.04.04.5.
If magnetic locks are used (only when required by code), they must be Securitron M Series.
Exit devices must be from approved manufacturers and series.
Door closers must be from approved manufacturers and series.
Power operators and electrified closers must be from approved manufacturers and series.
Automatic door opener push plates must be Camden or BEA.
